## Où j'en suis
Fernhill SAML SSO works end to end on staging: a real login with Fernhill's IdP succeeds, and JIT provisioning (#415) is merged. The RelayState fix (6d0e2b8) and group-to-role mapping (f4a91c7) are in #421, which is still open. Users are created as `viewer` because Fernhill has not yet added the groups claim, so admins cannot be told apart. The full test suite passed (1301 passed, 3 skipped). (source: s3-11, s3-04, s3-06, src-pr415, s3-09)

- [en-cours] Waiting for Fernhill IT to add the groups claim; Daniel is emailing them. (source: s3-05, s3-08)
- [en-cours] PR #421 is open, not merged: short RelayState and group-to-role mapping. (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421, 6d0e2b8, f4a91c7)
- [prochaine-étape] Get the groups claim from Fernhill IT, then check that Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins maps to `admin`. (source: s3-05, s3-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Demo on Thursday 19 Nov at 10:00 ET with the demo account `kestrel.test1` and one admin test account. (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] SP-initiated login failed at Fernhill's ADFS with "RelayState parameter is too long": the 143-byte return URL exceeds the 80-byte cap. Fixed by storing the URL in Redis and sending a short opaque ID. (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [question] Fernhill's Slack message says the groups claim comes after the demo, but the checklist needs it before. (source: src-slack-fernhill, src-linear-kes311)
- [question] Fernhill's Slack message asks for IdP-initiated login only and an `analyst` default role, which does not exist. Do we reply, and what do we say? (source: src-slack-fernhill, s3-07)
- [question] A note says SSO is enforced for all Fernhill users on Dec 1, with password login disabled. No verified source confirms it. (source: src-note-enforce, src-linear-kes311)
- [décision] The default role stays `viewer`; SP-initiated login stays on. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Users from an unverified domain are refused and not created. (source: src-pr415, s2-03)
- [décision] Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins maps to `admin`, everyone else `viewer`, configured per tenant. (source: s3-05)
- [décision] SAML only, no OIDC; both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. (source: s1-03)
